{{Quote|All this moisture is corroding my servo-motors.''"<br />"''Go up to level eight, get your head adjusted. It feels great.''"<br />"''That will feel...|A fellow droid speaking to this one just before getting attacked.|<ref name="dotd">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed in the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] on the [[Ruusan 2/Legends|moon]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] and served under command of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to trace the location of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], the [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], and sent a clone strike team lead by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|take it out]].<ref name="dotd" />

Meanwhile on the station, this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] along with a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 3 (Skytop Station)/Legends|fellow droid]] were on patrol. The other droid was complaining that the moisture in the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] atmosphere was corroding his servo-motors. This droid suggested that he go to level eight to get his head adjusted. Just as they finished chatting, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] intercepted them, and one of them ripped out the other droid's head. This droid was then shot and destroyed.<ref name="dotd" />
